environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a standard EC2 instance (m5.large) running Amazon Linux 2. The Vault transit backend at localhost:8200 is configured with a software-backed key (type=aes256-gcm96) stored in Vault's encrypted storage. The application service account has full access to both sign and verify operations on the 'session-key' named key. No network segmentation between the app and Vault. The container runs as root with no seccomp profile. An attacker who compromises any adjacent service can call Vault's sign endpoint to produce valid HMACs for arbitrary payloads.
